title: Claude Code docs: Claude Desktop, the Code tab
quotes: In the Claude Desktop app, Claude Code is the Code tab. The app also has chat and Cowork, which handles Dispatch and longer agentic work.
sessions appear in the session list at claude.ai/code and in the Claude apps on devices signed in to your claude.ai account
The desktop app reads the same settings files as the CLI
Cowork's configuration syncs through your claude.ai account
